decision_logic.galaxy_level: After halo closure, external chi calibration is still required.
decision_logic.halo_acceleration_level: For E28-like direct acceleration chi=1, the sum of state-differential init/history/profile/Born bounds across F+ and F- must be below |delta_ref| to guarantee sign.
decision_logic.survey_level: Only after a physical galaxy template exists should A03 window propagation and A04 covariance resume.

limits: No observed eBOSS galaxy or odd-vector access
No physical Born norm q measured
No physical halo-history derivative bound measured
No significance, p-value, or covariance inference

operator_decomposition.sign_certificate: B_Y,- + B_Y,+ < |Dhat| is sufficient to preserve the benchmark contrast sign
operator_decomposition.source_state: S_F = S_hat_F + dS_init_F + dS_hist_F + dS_prof_F + dS_Born_F

Born_remainder.form: If ||f_(n+1)|| <= q_F ||f_n|| with q_F<1, remainder beyond first order <= q_F/(1-q_F) times the first-order norm

finite_size_profile.form: Use E35/E38 moment bound delta(k)<=min(2,k^2<r^2>/6) together with the time-history envelope

halo_history.form: Use E37 endpoint+Lipschitz retarded bound once a physical L_k=sup|partial_t u_src(k,t)| is available

incoming_kinetic_state.form: B_init,F >= || G_F U_F(t,t_i) delta f_i,F || in the same final observable norm
incoming_kinetic_state.status: UNBOUNDED: E27 set incoming wake to zero as benchmark; E36 showed low moments do not identify hidden phase-space structure

tracer_response.form: Requires external chi_hat_F and B_chi,F. Without them E40 response reparameterization makes F non-identifiable in the linear source channel.
